changelog: Scanning: every car now records the date it was scanned in, so the Days column keeps counting up on its own even when D2C gives no day count — and re-scanning never resets it. Duplicates: a re-scan now matches an existing car by stock number (ignoring case/spacing) or by VIN, so scanning the same vehicle twice updates it instead of adding it again. Danger Zone: Clear Inventory is now per-section — All, New, Pre-owned, Certified, or Not published — each still password-protected and never touching Leads or Trade-In evaluations.
